question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 H 组：佛得角 vs 沙特阿拉伯，90 分钟三路赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group H: Cabo Verde vs Saudi Arabia, three-way 90-minute result?
one_liner_cn: Elo 仅差 2 分的五五开对决：沙特凭世界杯经验略占上风，佛得角首秀且阵容老化，平局概率亦不容忽视。
one_liner_en: A coin-flip with just 2 Elo points between them: Saudi Arabia edges it on World Cup experience over aging debutants Cabo Verde, with the draw far from negligible.

key_reasons.cn: 两队 Elo 几乎完全持平（佛得角 1578 第 68 / 沙特 1576 第 69），统计模型接近抛硬币。
key_reasons.en: Near-identical Elo ratings (Cabo Verde 1578, rank 68 vs Saudi Arabia 1576, rank 69) make the statistical baseline close to a coin flip.

key_reasons.cn: 沙特 4 月 17 日临阵换帅，Donis 仅率队 3 场（1 胜 1 平 1 负），磨合风险限制其经验优势。
key_reasons.en: Saudi Arabia sacked Renard on April 17; new coach Donis has only 3 matches in charge (1W 1D 1L), a cohesion risk that caps their experience edge.

key_reasons.cn: 佛得角历史首秀且主力脊柱老化（Vozinha 40、Stopira 38、Mendes 36），沙特则保留 2022 击败阿根廷的经验班底，故小幅向沙特修正 1pp。
key_reasons.en: Debutants Cabo Verde carry an aging spine (Vozinha 40, Stopira 38, Mendes 36) while Saudi Arabia retains its experienced 2022 core, justifying a small 1pp shift toward Saudi Arabia.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gives p_stat A 37.25% / draw 25.93% / B 36.82%; a bounded 1pp evidence adjustment (Saudi tournament experience vs Cabo Verde debut + aging core, offset by Saudi coaching upheaval) yields p_final. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity and thin evidence. No market/odds inputs of any kind.
